blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A dataset whose diagnostic label can be recovered from non-diagnostic information yields high, reproducible and uninformative model performance. We applied pre-training controls that see only image geometry, global texture, a sub-collection identifier or one covariate to six public mammography datasets, against a stop threshold of AUC 0.60. In KAU-BCMD, geometry alone predicted the BI-RADS class at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 in a public Kaggle archive; after resizing, texture alone gave 0.847. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix predicted malignancy at 0.7753; the restricted sub-collection passed geometry (0.5000) and texture (0.5810) but failed an identifier-order control added post hoc (test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM exceeded the stop on geometry (pooled mean 0.654 over 20 splits), a verdict statistic chosen post hoc; its official mass and calcification splits did not. M-SYNTH, INbreast and a partial VinDr-Mammo copy passed the few controls run. We release the code and derived tables. There is no quantum component in the inference path.
blocks.zh: 一个数据集的诊断标签可以从非诊断信息中取回,产生出高,可再生和不成型的模型性能. 我们应用了预训练控制,只看到图像几何,全局纹理,分集标识符或一个同变分化到6个公用乳房X线照相数据集,而停止阈值为AUC 0.60. 在KAU-BCMD中,光是几何就预言BI-RADS类在本地副本为AUC 1.0000,在公共的Kaggle档案中平均为0.979;再大小后,仅纹理就给出了0.847. 在CMMD中,子收集前缀预测恶性为0.7753;被限制的子收集通过几何(0.5000)和纹理(0.5810),但失败了标识-顺序控制附加后特设(test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM在几何学上超过了停站(集合值为0.654分20分),一种判决统计选择了后临时选择;其官方质量和钙分解没有. M-SYNTH, Inbreast 和一份部分VinDr-Mammo的拷贝通过少数控制运行. 我们发布代码和衍生表格。 推断路径中没有量子组件.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A machine-learning result on medical images is a statement about anatomy only if the label cannot be obtained in some other way. When the label is also recoverable from something that carries no diagnostic content, such as the width of the file, the sharpness left by an export step, or the position of a record in a list, every model trained on that dataset can score well, the scores replicate, and the replication says nothing about disease. The general phenomenon has been described as shortcut learning in deep neural networks [ 1 ] and as “Clever Hans” prediction [ 2 ] , and dataset bias was examined in computer vision earlier still [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 医学影像上的机器学习结果,只有在无法以某种其他方式获得标签时,才表示解剖学. 当标签也可以从没有诊断内容的东西中恢复,例如文件的宽度,导出步骤留下的尖锐度,或者记录在列表中的位置时,每个在该数据集上受过训练的模型都能得好分,得分复制,复制时不会说疾病. 一般现象被描述为在深层神经网络中的捷径学习[1]和"Clever Hans"预测[2],数据集偏差在早期的计算机视觉中被检查过仍然[3].

blocks.en: Medical imaging has supplied concrete cases. A deep-learning model for detecting pneumonia in chest radiographs showed variable generalisation performance in a cross-sectional study [ 4 ] . In pelvic radiographs, a deep-learning model predicted hip fracture using confounding patient and healthcare variables: the scanner model could itself be predicted from the image at an AUC of 1.00, and fracture prediction fell to chance on a test set in which fracture risk was balanced across patient and hospital-process variables [ 5 ] . The association between surgical skin markings in dermoscopic images and the diagnostic performance of a convolutional network for melanoma recognition has been studied [ 6 ] . Hidden stratification has been reported to cause clinically meaningful failures in machine learning for medical imaging [ 7 ] . For radiographic COVID-19 detection, models were reported to select shortcuts over signal [ 8 ] , and the methods proposed for automatic COVID-19 detection from X-ray images have been evaluated critically [ 9 ] . Methodological failures of this kind in machine learning for medical imaging have been surveyed together with recommendations [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 医疗成像提供了具体病例。 胸腔射电图中检测肺炎的深度学习模型显示,截面研究中呈现出可变的概括性表现[4]. 在盆腔射线图中,一个深层学习模型利用混淆的病人和保健变量预测臀部骨折:扫描模型本身可以从图像上以1.00的AUC来预测,骨折预测在一种测试中落空,在这种测试中,骨折风险在病人和医院-过程变量之间是平衡的[5]. 研究了皮肤皮肤外科标记与脑膜瘤诊断网络诊断性能之间的联系。 据报道,隐藏的分层在医学成像的机器学习中造成了临床上有意义的故障[7]. 关于放射线COVID-19探测,据报模型选择了超过信号的捷径[8],从X射线图像中自动COVID-19探测的拟议方法得到了批判性的评价[9]. 在机器学习医学成像方面这种方法上的失败已经与建议一道进行了调查。

blocks.en: Two neighbouring literatures describe the same defect in other terms. Leakage has been linked to a reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science [ 11 ] . In high-throughput biology, batch effects arise because measurements are affected by laboratory conditions, reagent lots and personnel, and they become a major problem when the batch is correlated with the outcome of interest [ 12 ] ; bias across sites has likewise been detected and corrected in multi-site neuroimaging datasets [ 13 ] . In mammography specifically, Samala et al. simulated feature leakage in the classification of breast masses and showed that validation performance could be strongly overestimated relative to an independent test set [ 14 ] ; Elmejgari et al. quantified patient-level leakage on CBIS-DDSM, including a protocol in which the official training and test splits are concatenated before cross-validation [ 15 ] ; Liao and Aagaard published an open codebase aimed at transparency in deep-learning diagnosis on CBIS-DDSM [ 16 ] ; Mabrok compared side-level with patient-level evaluation on CMMD [ 17 ] ; Zufiria et al. analysed potential biases in mammography datasets for deep-learning model development [ 18 ] ; and Garrucho et al. studied domain generalisation of mass detection in a multi-centre study [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 相邻的两部文献以其他术语描述同样的缺陷. 漏水与机器学习科学再生产危机有关[11]. 在高通量生物学中,由于测量受到实验室条件、试剂批量和人员的影响而产生批量效应,当批量与利益结果相关时,这些效应就成为一个重大问题;在多地点神经成像数据集中也发现了不同地点的偏差并进行了纠正[13]。 具体来说,在乳腺造影术中,Samala等人模拟了乳腺质量分类中的渗漏特征,并表明相对于独立测试集[14],验证性能可以大大高估;Elmejgari等人对CBIS-DDSM上的患者水平渗漏进行了量化,包括一项协议,在交叉校验[15]之前,官方培训和测试分解被调和;廖和阿加德公布了一个开放的密码库,旨在对CBIS-DDSM[16]进行深入学习诊断的透明度;Mabrok将侧水平与患者水平评价比较[17];Zufiria等人分析了乳腺造影术数据集中用于深层学习模型开发的潜在偏差[18];Garucho等人。 在多中心研究中研究了质量检测的域概论[19].

blocks.en: Reporting practice has responded mainly through documentation and checklists: datasheets for datasets [ 20 ] , the FAIR guiding principles for scientific data management and stewardship [ 21 ] , and a checklist for artificial intelligence in medical imaging intended as a guide for authors and reviewers [ 22 ] . Large public medical image datasets have been explored after their release [ 23 ] , and a review of eight machine-learning datasets in mammography against the FAIR principles found that they vary considerably, mixing digital captures with scanned film and differing in licensing, ease of access, labelling reliability and file formats [ 24 ] . Documentation describes a dataset; it does not by itself test whether the label can be predicted from the file.
blocks.zh: 报告做法主要通过文件和核对表作出反应:数据集数据表[20]、科学数据管理和管理法则指导原则[21]、医学成像中人工智能核对表作为作者和审查者的指南[22]。 大型公共医疗影像数据集在发布后进行了探索[23],对照FAIR原则对乳房X光照相八个机器学习数据集的审查发现,它们差异很大,将数字捕获与扫描胶片混合在一起,在许可证发放、访问便利、标签可靠性和文件格式上也存在差异[24]. 文档描述了一个数据集;它本身并不测试标签是否能够从文件中预测.

blocks.en: The datasets examined here are six: the King Abdulaziz University Breast Cancer Mammogram Dataset (KAU-BCMD) [ 25 ] ; the Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD) [ 26 , 27 ] , distributed by The Cancer Imaging Archive [ 28 ] ; CBIS-DDSM, the curated subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography [ 29 ] ; INbreast [ 30 ] ; VinDr-Mammo [ 31 ] ; and the simulated M-SYNTH cohort [ 32 ] . Such datasets are also pooled: one benchmark compilation collates images from six sources, among them DDSM, INbreast, KAU-BCMD and CMMD [ 33 ] . Pooling is the situation in which a batch that is correlated with the label matters most.
blocks.zh: 本文审查的数据集有6个:阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹国王大学乳腺癌乳腺图数据集(KAU-BCMD)[25];中国乳腺图数据库(CMMD)[26,27],由The Cancer Imaging Archive发行;CBIS-DDSM,筛选乳腺图数字数据库的编译子集[29];INBrest [30];VinDr-Mammo [31];模拟M-SYNTH组群[32]. 这种数据集也是集合的:一个基准汇编整理了六个来源的图像,其中包括DDSM、INBreast、KAU-BCMD和CMMD[33]。 集合是一批与标签关系最密切的情况。

blocks.en: We report what a small set of file-level controls returned on these six datasets, examined in several configurations (KAU-BCMD as a local copy and as a public Kaggle archive; CMMD pooled and restricted to one sub-collection). Three datasets fail at least one stop-role control. In KAU-BCMD, where the BI-RADS category is encoded as directory membership, a classifier given only image width, height, megapixels and aspect ratio separates BI-RADS 4/5 from BI-RADS 1 at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 over 20 patient-grouped splits in a public Kaggle archive; no image dimension is shared between the classes in either copy, and after resizing to a common 224 × \times 224 the texture control still gives 0.847 on the public archive. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix of the patient identifier alone predicts malignancy at AUC 0.7753. In CBIS-DDSM, geometry alone is associated with pathology at a mean AUC of 0.654 in the pooled cohort, 0.688 in the calcification cohort and 0.635 in the mass cohort; that verdict rests on a mean over repeated splits which was chosen after the results were seen, and on the single official splits the mass and calcification cohorts are below the stop. Three datasets pass every control that was run on them, and few were run: M-SYNTH (two controls), INbreast (geometry only, 0.486) and the available 59.8% subset of VinDr-Mammo (geometry only, 0.573).
blocks.zh: 我们报告这六套数据集的一小套文件级别控制器返回的情况,这些控制器在几个配置(KAU-BCMD作为本地副本和作为公共的Kaggle档案;CMMD集合并限于一个子集)中检查. 三套数据集至少一个停止作用控制失败. 在KAU-BCMD中,BI-RADS类别被编码为目录成员,一个分类器只赋予图像宽度,高度,兆像素和侧面比,将BI-RADS 4/5与BI-RADS 1在本地副本上隔开,在公共的Kaggle档案中以0.979的平均值划分20多个患者组分;两个副本中的类别之间没有图像维度共享,在重新缩放到通用的224×\times 224后,纹理控制仍然给予公共档案0.847. 在CMMD中,仅患者识别符的子收集前缀就预言了在AUC 0.7753的恶性. 在CBIS-DDSM中,只有几何学与病理有关,在集合组中,平均AUC为0.654,在钙化组中,0.688,在质量组中,0.635;这一判决取决于在看到结果后选择的大于反复分裂的平均值,在单一官分中,质量和钙化组在停止点以下。 3个数据集通过它们运行的每个控制器,运行的很少:M-SYNTH(两个控制器),INBreast(仅几何,0.486)和可用59.8%的VinDr-Mammo子集(仅几何,0.573).

blocks.en: CMMD restricted to its first sub-collection is in neither group. It passes the registered geometry and texture controls and then fails a control we added afterwards: the serial number in the patient identifier alone predicts malignancy at a test AUC of 0.9926. We report this as the paper’s own demonstration that a pass on the registered controls is not a certificate.
blocks.zh: CMMD仅限其第一次子集成,两个组都不在. 它通过注册的几何和纹理控制,然后失败了我们之后添加的控制:仅在患者识别符中的序列号就预言了在测试AUC为0.9926时的恶性. 我们将此报告为报纸本身的证明,即通过注册控制不是证书。

blocks.en: Relative to the work cited above, this paper adds measurements, a procedure and a release, and no new method. The measurements are control AUCs for named public datasets and copies, including the unremarkable ones. The procedure is to fix a small set of impoverished controls and a threshold in writing before a model of interest is trained, and to record which analytic choices were made after results were seen. The release is the code, the notebooks with their outputs and the derived tables. We make no priority claim. We queried the CrossRef bibliographic index with the seven search strings listed in Methods and inspected the first six records returned for each; these included a report of patient-level leakage on CBIS-DDSM [ 15 ] and an evaluation study on CMMD [ 17 ] , and none of them, judged by its title, reported a geometry–label association in KAU-BCMD or CBIS-DDSM or an association between the CMMD identifier and malignancy. This was not a systematic review, and records beyond the first six per query were not examined. Two preprints, identified by a web search on the same day and read at abstract level, are closely related. Hajishafiezahramini et al. [ 34 ] found that a classifier separated the dataset of origin almost perfectly across three mammography sources that included CBIS-DDSM and CMMD, after identical preprocessing, and that adding externally sourced positive cases lowered screening performance. Zafari et al. [ 35 ] describe a harmonisation pipeline and quantify distributional differences across CBIS-DDSM, a CMMD derivative and VinDr-Mammo. Both address differences between datasets; the controls reported here ask whether the label is recoverable from non-diagnostic information within one dataset.
blocks.zh: 相对于上述工作,本文增加了测量,程序和发布,没有新的方法. 测量是控制AUC对命名的公共数据集和拷贝,包括不可注意的数据集和拷贝. 程序是在培训利益模式之前确定一套小的薄弱控制,以及一个书面门槛,并记录在看到结果后作出的分析选择。 发行是代码,笔记本及其输出和衍生的表格. 我们没有提出优先要求。 我们询问了Cross Reference书目索引和《方法》中所列的7个搜索字符串,并检查了每一份退回的前6份记录;这些记录包括一份病人在CBIS-DDSM [15] 上的泄漏报告,以及一份关于CMMD [17] 的评价研究报告,根据标题判断,没有一个报告KAU-BCMD或CBIS-DDSM的几何标签协会,或CMMDS识别符和恶意之间的协会。 这不是一次系统的审查,而且没有审查前6次查询之后的记录。 两个预印,由同日的网络搜索确定,抽象阅读,两者密切相关. Hajishafiezahramini等人[34]发现,一个分类器在进行相同的预处理后,几乎完美地将原产地数据集从包括CBIS-DDSM和CMMD在内的三个乳房X线照相来源中分离出来,加上外部来源的阳性病例降低了筛查性能。 扎法里等人著. [35] 描述一个协调管道,并量化CBIS-DDSM、CMMD衍生物和VinDr-Mammo之间的分配差异。 两者都涉及数据集之间的差异;这里报告的控件询问标签是否可以从一个数据集内的非诊断信息中恢复.

blocks.en: The work arose while benchmarks comparing quantum with classical machine-learning models were being set up on clinical breast images, and that context explains why the controls were run at all. Had they not been run on the local KAU-BCMD copy, we would expect every arm of the planned benchmark, quantum and classical alike, to have scored near AUC 1.0, and a quantum arm to have been reported at roughly 0.99; such a result would have been reproducible, internally consistent and uninformative. A recently proposed framework for quantum advantage [ 36 ] , which is a proposal and not a standard, makes validated correctness of the output the first of its two criteria; a dataset whose label is readable from its file header fails that requirement for every arm equally, before any computation begins. This paper reports no quantum advantage, no speed-up and no quantum-enhanced performance. Every quantum run in the wider programme to date is a classical statevector simulation. There is no quantum component in the inference path.
blocks.zh: 这项工作是随着在临床乳房图像上建立将量子与古典机器学习模型相比较的基准而开始的,这一背景解释了为什么控制是完全运行的。 如果它们没有在本地的KAU-BCMD副本上运行,我们预计计划基准的每个臂,无论是量子还是古典的量子,都会在AUC 1.0附近得分,一个量子臂被报告为大约0.99;这样的结果本来是可复制的,内部一致的和不知情的. 最近提出的量子优势框架[36],这是一个提议,而不是一个标准,它使输出的验证正确性成为它的两个标准中的第一个;一个其标签可以从文件头读取的数据集在任何计算开始之前,都同样没有满足每个臂的要求. 本文报告没有量子优势,没有速度和量子增强性能. 迄今为止,在更广泛的方案中,每个量子运行都是古典的状态器模拟. 推论路径中没有量子元件.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Controls and stop rule
blocks.zh: 2.1 控制和停止规则

blocks.en: Each control is a classifier trained on an input that should carry no diagnostic information, scored by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) [ 37 ] against the diagnostic label. A control is expected to score about 0.50.
blocks.zh: 每个控制器是经过培训的分类器,其输入应不包含诊断信息,按接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)[37]下区域对照诊断标签打分. 一个控制预期得分约为0.50分.

blocks.en: Table 1: The controls. “Stop” controls halt a study when they exceed the threshold; the covariate control is reported as context only.
blocks.zh: 表1:控制措施。 “停止”控制在超过阈值时停止研究;共变控制仅作为上下文报告。

blocks.en: The classifier for every control is scikit-learn’s HistGradientBoostingClassifier with default hyperparameters and random_state = 0 . It is deliberately untuned: a tuned control would invite the objection that the gate had been optimised to fail.
blocks.zh: 每个控件的分类器是 sikit-learn 的 HistGradientBoosting 分类器,带有默认的超参数和随机_状态= 0 。 它被故意不调和:调谐的控制会招致人们反对,认为该门已被优化为故障。

blocks.en: The stop threshold of 0.60 was fixed in writing before any control was run on CMMD. The registered sentence states that the geometry and texture controls must return approximately 0.50 AUC on the frozen test split and that the benchmark stops and the dataset is investigated if either “exceeds 0.60”. The follow-up notebooks implement the rule as a fail when the mean AUC is greater than or equal to 0.60. The two formulations differ only at the boundary. No value reported in this paper lies at the boundary, so no verdict depends on the difference.
blocks.zh: 在对CMMD进行控制之前,0.60的停机阈值是书面确定的。 注册的句子说,几何和纹理控制必须在冷冻试验分解时返回约0.50AUC,如果“超过0.60”,则对基准停止和数据集进行调查。 后续笔记本在平均AUC大于或等于0.60时作为失败执行规则. 两种配方仅在边界上有所不同. 本文中报告的任何价值均不位于边界,因此任何判决都不得取决于差异.

blocks.en: The threshold is a screening rule, not a statistical test. It attaches no p-value or error rate to a verdict, and it is not offered as a universal boundary between acceptable signal and problematic leakage: a control below it does not show that a dataset is free of shortcuts, and a control above it does not measure how far a downstream model would exploit them. Its role is operational, deciding whether training proceeds or the dataset is investigated first. Three properties support that use. First, the controls carry no diagnostic content, so their expected AUC is 0.50, and 0.60 lies well outside the split-to-split variation of the controls that returned values near chance in this study: the largest standard deviation over 20 repeated splits was 0.0217 (INbreast geometry, the smallest dataset), which places 0.60 at 4.6 standard deviations above 0.50, and no single split of the four controls with means within 0.05 of chance exceeded 0.5570. Second, under a binormal model with equal variances an AUC of 0.60 corresponds to a standardised mean difference of 0.36, a small effect, so the rule flags label information that is modest in size but larger than the sampling variation seen here. Third, every verdict was re-scored at thresholds of 0.55, 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75, and the conclusions that do and do not depend on the choice are stated in Section 5.
blocks.zh: 门槛是筛选规则,而不是统计测试。 它不将p值或误差率附加在判决上,也不将其作为可接受的信号和问题泄漏之间的通用边界:它下面的控制不能显示数据集没有捷径,上面的控制不能衡量下游模型能在多大程度上利用这些数据。 其作用是可操作的,决定培训是否进行,还是首先调查数据集。 三个属性支持这种使用. 首先,控制器没有诊断内容,因此其预期的AUC为0.50,0.60远远不在本研究中返回值的控件的分割至分割变异之外:20个重复分裂的最大标准偏差为0.0217(Inbrest几何,最小数据集),使0.60位在0.50以上4.6位标准偏差,而4个控制器中没有任何一个在0.05范围内的手段的分割超过0.5570. 第二,在具有同等差异的双正常模型下,一个0.60的AUC对应标准平均差0.36,这是一个小效果,所以规则旗标记信息在尺寸上并不大,但比这里的取样变化更大. 第三,每项判决都以0.55、0.65、0.70和0.75的门槛重新评分,第5节说明了哪些结论确实和不取决于选择。

blocks.en: Two features of the design matter. The geometry control decodes no pixels; it reads four integers from each file header. The covariate control is reported but never used as a stop, because an association between a demographic variable and the outcome can be a property of the clinical population and not a defect of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 设计事项的两个特征. 几何控制解码无像素;它从每个文件头读取四个整数. 共变控制被报告,但从未作为停止使用,因为人口变量与结果之间的关联可能是临床人群的财产,而不是数据集的缺陷.

blocks.en: 2.2 Registration status and deviations
blocks.zh: 2.2 登记状况和偏离情况

blocks.en: The registration referred to throughout is an internal, dated written protocol. It was not deposited in a public registry. The protocol and its dated deviations log are part of the release (Data availability).
blocks.zh: 在整个登记过程中提及的登记是一份内部书面协议。 它没有交存于公共登记处。 协议及其日期的偏差日志是发布(数据可用性)的一部分.

blocks.en: The geometry, texture and single-covariate controls and the 0.60 threshold were registered for CMMD before any model was trained. The KAU-BCMD controls on the local copy were not registered: they were run as an ad hoc diagnostic during benchmark set-up, and the gate was written into the protocol afterwards as a consequence of what they found. The KAU-BCMD result on the local copy is therefore exploratory. The batch/site control was promoted to a stop role after the CMMD confound had been found by investigation. The identifier-order control was added later still (Section 2.6). The M-SYNTH controls were run under the protocol of a separate study.
blocks.zh: 在培训任何模型之前,CMMD就登记了几何、纹理和单变量控制以及0.60阈值。 KAU-BCMD对本地拷贝的控制没有注册:它们在基准设置期间作为临时诊断运行,之后由于发现的结果,门被写入协议. 因此,KAU-BCMD在当地副本上的结果是探索性的。 在经调查发现CMMD混乱后,将批量/现场控制提升为停止作用。 后来添加了标识-顺序控制(第2.6节)。 M-SYNTH控制是在一项单独研究的协议下运行的.

blocks.en: Two further items were registered before they were run, and were carried out in a follow-up round of analyses with the following deviations. Throughout, “initial” refers to the first round of controls (Table 2) and “follow-up” to the second round, scored over repeated splits (Table 3).
blocks.zh: 另有两件物品在运行前已经登记,并在后续分析中进行了如下偏差。 在整个过程中,“初始”是指第一轮控制(表2)和第二轮控制“后续”,分数为重复分数(表3)。

blocks.en: 1. A fresh download of the public KAU-BCMD distribution was registered for two publisher routes under an institutional account. It was run on one route only, a Kaggle-hosted archive downloaded by a team member and held in a cloud copy, and it was scored under 20 repeated patient-grouped splits instead of one. 2. Gates on five further public datasets were registered: CBIS-DDSM, VinDr-Mammo, INbreast, the RSNA screening-mammography challenge dataset [ 38 ] and BreastMNIST [ 39 ] , each with four controls and a bit-depth check on a frozen split. Three of the five were run (CBIS-DDSM, INbreast, VinDr-Mammo), with the geometry control only, and each was scored under 20 repeated patient-grouped five-fold splits; where an official split exists, its single-split AUC is reported beside the mean.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 公开的KAU-BCMD发行版在机构账户下注册了两条出版商路线的新下载。 它只运行在一条路线上,一个Kaggle托管的档案被一个团队成员下载并保存在云拷贝中,它的得分低于20个重复的患者分组分数而不是一个. 2. 登记了另外五个公共数据集的封面:CBIS-DDSM、VinDr-Mammo、INBreast、RSNA筛选-映射挑战数据集[38]和MureMNIST[39],每个数据集有四个控制器,并对一个冻结的拆分进行略深的检查。 5人中有3人被运行(CBIS-DDSM,INBreast,VinDr-Mammo),只有几何控制,每人得分不到20次重复的患者分组5倍的分数;如果存在正式的分数,则在平均值旁报告其单分的AUC.

blocks.en: A fresh download of the public KAU-BCMD distribution was registered for two publisher routes under an institutional account. It was run on one route only, a Kaggle-hosted archive downloaded by a team member and held in a cloud copy, and it was scored under 20 repeated patient-grouped splits instead of one.
blocks.zh: 公开的KAU-BCMD发行版在机构账户下注册了两条出版商路线的新下载。 它只运行在一条路线上,一个Kaggle托管的档案被一个团队成员下载并保存在云拷贝中,它的得分低于20个重复的患者分组分数而不是一个.

blocks.en: Gates on five further public datasets were registered: CBIS-DDSM, VinDr-Mammo, INbreast, the RSNA screening-mammography challenge dataset [ 38 ] and BreastMNIST [ 39 ] , each with four controls and a bit-depth check on a frozen split. Three of the five were run (CBIS-DDSM, INbreast, VinDr-Mammo), with the geometry control only, and each was scored under 20 repeated patient-grouped five-fold splits; where an official split exists, its single-split AUC is reported beside the mean.
blocks.zh: 在另外5个公共数据集上的盖茨被注册:CBIS-DDSM,VinDr-Mammo,INBreast,RSNA筛选-映射挑战数据集[38]和MureMNIST [39],每个数据集有4个控制器,并对一个冷冻的拆分进行点深度检查. 5人中有3人被运行(CBIS-DDSM,INBreast,VinDr-Mammo),只有几何控制,每人得分不到20次重复的患者分组5倍的分数;如果存在正式的分数,则在平均值旁报告其单分的AUC.

blocks.en: The 0.60 threshold and the 20-split design were fixed before the follow-up runs. The decision to apply the threshold to the mean over the 20 splits, and not to a single split, was taken after the results were seen. It matters for CBIS-DDSM (Section 3.5).
blocks.zh: 0.60的阈值和20分的设计在后续运行前被固定. 在看到结果之后,决定对20分数以上的中间数适用门槛,而不是一次。 这对CBIS-DDSM(第3.5节)很重要。

blocks.en: 2.3 Datasets and copies analysed
blocks.zh: 2.3 分析数据集和副本

blocks.en: Table 2: Datasets and copies analysed in the initial round.
blocks.zh: 表2:在第一轮中分析的数据集和副本。

blocks.en: The dataset paper for KAU-BCMD states that the dataset was annotated and reviewed by three radiologists [ 25 ] . The dataset paper for CMMD describes two branches, one with biopsy-confirmed benign or malignant labels and one with known molecular subtypes [ 26 ] ; the two-part structure of CMMD is therefore documented by its authors and is not a finding of this work. That paper reports fewer mammograms than the number of image files in the archive manifest we analysed. We did not reconcile the two counts, and every CMMD count in this paper is taken from the manifest and the label file.
blocks.zh: KAU-BCMD的数据集文件称,该数据集由三位放射学家注释和审查[25]. CMMD的数据集文件描述了两个分支,一个分支具有活检确认的良性或恶性标签,另一个分支具有已知的分子亚型[26];因此CMMD的两部分结构被作者所记载,并不是这一作品的发现. 这份论文报告的乳房X光图比我们分析的档案清单中的图像文件数量要少。 我们没有调和这两项罪名,本文中每个CMMD的计数都取自清单和标签文件.

blocks.en: Table 3: Datasets and copies analysed with the geometry control in the follow-up round.
blocks.zh: 表3:后续回合中用几何控制分析数据集和副本.

blocks.en: Patients were grouped as follows: KAU-BCMD by the year-and-case identifier in the file name, with a sensitivity analysis grouping by case number only; CBIS-DDSM by the patient identifier across both cohorts; INbreast by the anonymised patient identifier in the file name; VinDr-Mammo by study identifier as a proxy for the patient.
blocks.zh: 患者分类如下: KAU-BCMD 按文件名中的年与年标识符,仅按病例号进行灵敏度分析分组; CBIS-DDSM 按患者标识符对两组患者进行分组; 在文件名中的匿名患者标识符进行压缩; VinDr-Mammo通过研究标识符作为患者的代名词.

blocks.en: The scoring protocols are not identical across datasets and we do not present them as equivalent. The local KAU-BCMD copy was cross-validated because no frozen split was ever created for it: the dataset was stopped before splitting. CMMD and M-SYNTH were scored once on a frozen split. The controls available also differ, because the recorded metadata differ: M-SYNTH has no patient-identifier prefix and no age, so batch and covariate controls do not exist for it, and its texture control is a 15-feature whole-image physics bank and not the four-feature bank used on the clinical datasets.
blocks.zh: 各个数据集的评分协议并不相同,我们不把它们作为等效的。 本地的KAU-BCMD拷贝被交叉验证,因为从未为此创建过冷冻分拆:数据集在拆分前被停止. CMMD和M-SYNTH在一次冰冻的分裂中一度得分. 可用的控制也有所不同,因为记录的元数据不同: M-SYNTH没有患者识别前缀,也没有年龄,因此批量和共变控制对于它来说并不存在,它的纹理控制是一个15度全像物理库,而不是临床数据集中使用的四度库.

blocks.en: 2.4 Preprocessing remedies for KAU-BCMD
blocks.zh: 2.4 KAU-BCMD的预处理补救措施

blocks.en: Three standard remedies were applied in turn and the control re-scored: resizing every image to a common 224 × \times 224; equalising to a common 467-pixel short axis and then resizing; and restricting to a resolution-matched subset below 0.5 megapixels. In the two resizing conditions the geometry features are constant by construction, so the control used is texture only.
blocks.zh: 依次应用了三种标准补救方法,控制重排:将每个图像重排为普通的224×\times 224;等于通用的467像素短轴,然后重排大小;限制在0.5兆像素以下的分辨率匹配子集. 在两个再大小条件中,几何特征通过构造是恒定的,所以所使用的控制只有纹理.

blocks.en: The initial analysis named the four texture statistics without defining them numerically. For the follow-up re-run on the public archive they were fixed as follows: 8-bit greyscale; bilinear resampling; Laplacian variance as the variance of the 4-connected discrete Laplacian; gradient energy as the mean of dx 2 + dy 2 by central differences; intensity standard deviation as the pixel standard deviation; contrast range as the 99th minus the 1st percentile. The local and public texture values are therefore not demonstrably computed with identical definitions.
blocks.zh: 初步分析为这四个纹理统计命名,但没有用数字定义. 为了在公共档案中进行后续再运行,它们被确定如下: 8位灰度; 双线性复刻; Laplacian 差异作为 4 连接的离散 Laplacian 的差异; 梯度能量作为 dx 2 + dy 2 的平均值通过中心差异; 强度标准偏差作为像素标准偏差; 对比范围为 99 减去 1% 。 因此,地方和公共的纹理价值没有用相同的定义来计算。

blocks.en: 2.5 Frozen splits for CMMD
blocks.zh: 2.5 CMMD的冻片

blocks.en: The CMMD splits are stratified by the patient’s worst finding and grouped by patient, with seed 20261020, and were written to disk before any model was trained. The unit of analysis is the breast, because 30 of the 97 patients with two labelled breasts have a different classification on each side. After the texture control failed on the pooled dataset the protocol was amended to the first sub-collection (D1) and the splits were re-frozen, before any model was trained. The released split files are these D1 splits: 605 training, 171 validation and 331 test breasts, the test split holding 168 malignant and 163 benign breasts.
blocks.zh: CMMD的分裂由患者最糟糕的发现分级,由患者分组,种子20261020,在任何模型训练之前被写成磁盘. 分析的单位是乳房,因为97个有2个标签乳房的病人中有30个在两侧有不同的分类. 在集合数据集的纹理控制失败后,协议被修正为第一个子集(D1),拆分被重新冻结,在任何模型训练之前. 释放的分裂文件是这些D1分裂:605训练,171验证和331测试乳房,测试分裂持有168个恶性乳房和163个良性乳房.

blocks.en: 2.6 Identifier-order control (post hoc)
blocks.zh: 2.6 识别器-订单控制(事后临时)

blocks.en: CMMD patient identifiers have the form D1-0001 . After the registered gate had passed CMMD D1, the numeric part of the identifier was used as the only feature of the same untuned classifier. It was scored on the frozen D1 validation and test splits, and over 20 repeated patient-grouped five-fold splits of the 1,107 D1 breasts. This control was not one of the four registered controls. It is exploratory, and it is labelled post hoc wherever it appears.
blocks.zh: CMMD患者识别器的表格为D1-001。 在注册的门通过CMMD D1后,标识符的数值部分被用作同一未调解分类器的唯一特征. 它在冰冻的D1验证和测试分裂上得分,超过20个重复的患者组合的5倍分裂的1,107 D1乳房. 这种控制不是四个登记控制之一。 它是探索性的,无论出现在哪里,都贴上临时标签。

blocks.en: The same control was subsequently applied to CBIS-DDSM, whose patient identifiers have the form P_00016 . Labels were taken from the four public case-description files of the archive [ 28 ] , and no image was read. The unit was the image (patient, side and view within a cohort), positive if any lesion on it was malignant, as in the geometry control. It was scored over 20 repeated patient-grouped five-fold splits for each cohort and for both cohorts pooled, grouping by patient across cohorts, and on the official training and test files of each cohort. It was not run on INbreast or VinDr-Mammo, whose copies are held in cloud storage that was not accessible for this addition, or on KAU-BCMD, which already fails on geometry.
blocks.zh: 随后对CBIS-DDSM也采用了同样的控制,其患者识别特征为P_00016. 标签取自档案的4个公开案件描述档案[28],没有读到图像. 单位是影像(患者、侧面和群中视线),如果有损伤,则呈阳性,如几何控制。 每组和两个组别,按各组别病人分组,以及每组别的正式培训和测试档案,共得20多分。 它没有运行在INBreast或VinDr-Mammo上,其副本被保存在云存储器中,而这种添加是无法访问的,也没有运行在KAU-BCMD上,在几何上已经失败了.

blocks.en: 2.7 Statistics
blocks.zh: 2.7 统计

blocks.en: The initial controls are each reported as a single AUC, run once at random_state = 0 . The follow-up controls are reported as the mean, standard deviation (SD), minimum and maximum of the out-of-fold AUC over 20 repeated patient-grouped five-fold splits ( StratifiedGroupKFold with shuffling and split seeds 0–19; the model is fixed at random_state = 0 because the classifier is deterministic for a given training set), with the verdict taken on the mean. No p-value is reported for any control and no multiplicity correction is applied: the gate is a screen against an absolute threshold and not a test of a null hypothesis, and correcting for multiplicity would make a safety screen more permissive. No dispersion is available for the initial controls.
blocks.zh: 初始控制器分别报告为单AUC,一次随机运行_状态=0. 后续控制被报告为平均,标准偏差(SD),最小和最大值外的AUC超过20个重复的患者分组的5倍分数(StraduateGroupKFold,具有洗牌和分裂种子0–19;模型固定在随机_状态=0,因为分类器对特定训练集具有决定力),对平均值做出判断. 没有报告任何控件的p值,也没有应用多重校正:闸门是相对于绝对阈值的屏幕,而不是对无效假设的测试,对多重的校正会使安全屏更加宽容. 初步控制没有分散。

blocks.en: The follow-up analyses ran under Python 3.13.5 with scikit-learn 1.9.1, pandas 3.1.0, numpy 2.5.4, pydicom 3.0.2 and Pillow 13.0.0. The software versions of the initial analyses were not recorded.
blocks.zh: 后续分析在Python 3.13.5下进行,有scikit-learn 1.9.1,熊猫3.1.0,numpy 2.5.4,pydicom 3.02和Pillow 13.0.0. 没有记录初步分析的软件版本。

blocks.en: 2.8 No quantum component
blocks.zh: 2.8 国家 无量子组件

blocks.en: No circuit, simulated or otherwise, is constructed or evaluated anywhere in this study. The gate is a gradient-boosting classifier on impoverished inputs.
blocks.zh: 本研究的任何地方均不建造或评价任何模拟或其他电路。 门是贫困投入的梯度促进分类器。

blocks.en: 2.9 Literature search
blocks.zh: 2.9 国家 文献搜索

blocks.en: The statement in the Introduction about earlier reports rests on queries to the CrossRef bibliographic index made during the preparation of this article, with the first six records inspected for each of these strings: “KAU-BCMD mammogram dataset classification deep learning”; “CMMD Chinese Mammography Database data leakage batch sub-collection”; “CBIS-DDSM data leakage patient overlap training test split”; “shortcut learning mammography spurious correlation image size dataset bias”; “duplicate images public mammography dataset INbreast CBIS-DDSM leakage”; “label leakage file metadata DICOM header medical imaging dataset”; and “image resolution confound deep learning medical image dataset class label image size”.
blocks.zh: 在导言中,关于以前报告的陈述是基于对撰写本条时提出的交叉参考书目索引的询问,检查了前六条记录的每个字符串:“KAU-BCMD乳房X线组数据集分类深层学习”、“CMMD中国乳房X线组数据库数据泄漏批次收集”、“CBIS-DDSM数据泄漏病人重复培训测试分裂”、“短期学习乳房X线组图像大小错位”;“复制图像公共乳房X线组数据东端CBIS-DDSM泄漏”、“标签泄漏文件元数据DICOM头部医疗成像数据集”;以及“图像分辨率混淆了深层学习的医学成像数据集类标签图像大小”。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.zh: 表4列出了每个控制结果。 图2显示的是同一行。
