blocks.en: Three datasets fail at least one stop-role control: KAU-BCMD, CMMD and CBIS-DDSM. Three pass every control that was run on them: M-SYNTH (two controls), INbreast (geometry only) and the available subset of VinDr-Mammo (geometry only). CMMD restricted to D1 passes the two registered stop controls and fails the identifier-order control added post hoc; it is not counted among the passes. CBIS-DDSM passes the identifier-order control in both cohorts and pooled (Section 3.4) and remains counted among the failures on geometry.
blocks.zh: 3个数据集至少一个停止作用控制失败:KAU-BCMD,CMMD和CBIS-DDSM. 三个通过在它们身上运行的每个控制:M-SYNTH(两个控制),INBreast(仅几何)和现有的VinDr-Mammo子集(仅几何). 仅限于D1的CMMD通过两个已注册的中途站控制器,并未能通过身份识别-顺序控制器添加的后置临时控制器;它不计入通行证中. CBIS-DDSM在组群和集合中都通过标识顺序控制(第3.4节),仍然属于几何学故障。

blocks.en: 3.2 KAU-BCMD: the class is a function of the file header
blocks.zh: 3.2 KAU- BCMD: 类是文件头的一个函数

blocks.en: Table 5: Image dimensions by class in the labelled KAU-BCMD folder (local copy).
blocks.zh: 表5:标注的KAU-BCMD文件夹中按类别分列的图像维度(本地副本).

blocks.en: In the local copy every image above 5 megapixels is BI-RADS 1, 1,552 of them, and every BI-RADS 4 image is 0.27 megapixels. The negatives occupy three sizes; the positives are small and, for BI-RADS 5, individually sized. This pattern is what separate export or cropping procedures for the two classes would produce; we did not observe how the files were made. The class is recoverable from the file header, and the geometry control returns AUC 1.0000.
blocks.zh: 在本地复制的5兆像素以上的每个图像是BI-RADS 1,1,552个,每个BI-RADS 4的图像是0.27兆像素. 负数占3个大小;正数小,对于BI-RADS 5,单个大小. 这种模式是这两个类别不同的出口或裁剪程序会产生的结果;我们没有看到文件是如何制作的。 该类从文件头可回收,几何控制返回AUC 1.0000.

blocks.en: Image content does not explain the separation. Visual inspection at matched display size shows that both classes are whole-breast craniocaudal and mediolateral-oblique views and not lesion crops (Figure 1). What differs is how the files were produced: in the initial analysis the positives carried systematically more high-frequency energy per pixel than the negatives.
blocks.zh: 图像内容无法解释分离. 相匹配显示大小的视觉检查显示,这两个班级都是全胸脑和中度-盲视,而不是损伤作物(图1)。 不同之处在于文件是如何生成的:在初始分析中,阳性每个像素所携带的系统高频能量比阴性更强.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Sample images by class from the local KAU-BCMD copy. Two images from each of the three BI-RADS classes of the labelled folder, shown at matched display size with the native pixel dimensions printed above each panel (BI-RADS 1: 2816 × \times 3584; BI-RADS 4: 467 × \times 578; BI-RADS 5: 477 × \times 569 and 330 × \times 578). Both classes are whole-breast craniocaudal and mediolateral-oblique views and not lesion crops. In this copy the negative class occupies three image sizes (2816 × \times 3584, n = 1,552; 1284 × \times 577, n = 237; 824 × \times 578, n = 76), the BI-RADS 4 images two (467 × \times 578, n = 98; 482 × \times 578, n = 4), each of the 24 BI-RADS 5 images has a unique size, and no positive image shares its dimensions with any negative image; a classifier given only width, height, megapixels and aspect ratio separates the classes at AUC 1.0000 under patient-grouped five-fold cross-validation. Images are from the King Abdulaziz University Breast Cancer Mammogram Dataset (KAU-BCMD; Alsolami et al. [ 25 ] ), licensed under CC BY 4.0, and are resized for display.
blocks.zh: 图 2:从本地的KAU-BCMD复制品中分级采集图像样本. 标签文件夹的三个BI-RADS类各有两幅图像,显示的显示大小与每个面板上印的本地像素尺寸相匹配(BI-RADS 1: 2816 ×\times 3584;BI-RADS 4: 467 ×\times 578;BI-RADS 5: 477 ×\times 569和330\times 578)。 两个班级都是全breast craniocaudal和中庸-盲视,而不是损伤作物. 本拷贝中,负类占3个图像大小(2816 × \times 3584,n = 1 552;1284 × \times 577,n = 237;824 × \times 578,n = 76),BI-RADS 4个图像2(467 × \times 578,n = 98;482 × \times 578,n = 4),24个BI-RADS 5个图像中每个图像都有独特的大小,没有正图像与任何负图像共用其尺寸;一个只给出宽度,高度,兆像素和侧面比的分类器在患者组合的5倍交叉验证下将AUC 1.0000的类分离. 图片来自阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹国王大学乳腺癌乳腺图数据集(KAU-BCMD;Asolami et al. [25]),根据CC BY 4.0获得许可,并调整尺寸以展示.

blocks.en: The public Kaggle archive shows the same association. The archive was compared file by file with its extracted copy: all 2,378 images match in folder, file name, dimensions and byte size. Its BI-RADS 1 dimensions and counts are identical to Table 5. Its BI-RADS 4 images are 1267 × \times 578 (98) and 1282 × \times 578 (4): the same counts and heights as the local copy but exactly 800 pixels wider. The local folder was therefore a different export of the same images and not a transcription of the archive; the local copy was a PNG folder produced from a DICOM export. The 24 BI-RADS 5 images again have 24 distinct sizes, all 183–477 pixels wide. No dimension is shared between the classes in the archive either.
blocks.zh: 公共的Kaggle档案显示同样的关联. 档案被按文件与其提取的复制品进行对比:所有2 378幅图像在文件夹,文件名称,维度和字节大小上都匹配. 它的BI-RADS 1尺寸和计数与表5相同. 它的BI-RADS 4的图像是1267 × \times 578(98)和 1282 × \times 578 (4): 和本地复制的一样的计数和高度,但正好有800像素宽度. 因此,本地文件夹是同一图像的不同导出,而不是存档的抄本;本地副本是用DICOM导出的一个PNG文件夹。 24幅BI-RADS 5图像再次有24幅不同大小,全部183–477像素宽. 档案中的类别之间也没有共享维度。

blocks.en: Table 6: Geometry control on the public KAU-BCMD archive, BI-RADS 1 against 4/5. All rows are means over 20 repeated patient-grouped five-fold splits.
blocks.zh: 表6:公共KAU-BCMD档案上的几何控制,BI-RADS 1对4/5. 所有行是指超过20次重复的患者分组5倍的分裂.

blocks.en: The archive value is below the local 1.0000 for an identifiable reason. One patient holds all four 1282-pixel BI-RADS 4 images. A width of 1282 lies between the positive width 1267 and the negative width 1284, so in any split that places this patient in the test fold the classifier has never seen that width and ranks the four images with the negatives. They are misranked in every split, and no other image is; a lookup on exact image size, with no fitting, gives 1.0000. In the local export, where the BI-RADS 4 width is 467 pixels and well below every negative width, a single threshold separates the classes, which is consistent with the 1.0000 measured there.
blocks.zh: 存档值低于当地1.0000,原因可以识别. 一个病人持有所有四个1282-像素BI-RADS 4图像. 1282的宽度介于正宽1267和负宽1284之间,因此在将这个病人置于测试折叠器中的任何分裂中,分类器从未见过这个宽度,并将四个图像与负数排列. 在每个分割中,它们都被误排,没有其它图像是;一个精确图像大小的搜索,没有匹配,给出1.0000. 在本地出口中,BI-RADS 4宽度为467像素,远低于每个负宽度,一个单一的阈值将分类分开,这与那里测得的1.0000一致.

blocks.en: Preprocessing did not remove the association. On the local copy, resizing everything to 224 × \times 224 removes the geometry channel and leaves a texture difference that still separates the classes at 0.8625; equalising to a common 467-pixel short axis before resizing gave 0.9297; and the resolution-matched subset returned 1.0000, because no true match exists: the “matched” negatives are at 0.48 megapixels against 0.27 megapixels for the positives. On the public archive the three remedies give 0.8465 after resizing (SD 0.0110, range 0.8233–0.8641), 0.8529 after short-axis equalisation (SD 0.0097, range 0.8342–0.8743) and 0.9800 on the subset below 0.5 megapixels (SD 0.0112, range 0.9649–1.0000), which there holds 76 BI-RADS 1 and 24 BI-RADS 5 images from 28 patients. On the local copy, short-axis equalisation scored higher than plain resizing. That observation does not replicate on the public archive, where the two differ by 0.006, within one SD, and it is not claimed here. Our interpretation, which we did not test further, is that resampling cannot give the two classes a common history: it cannot restore information that the negatives do not have at the common scale, nor add to them the compression signature that the positives carry.
blocks.zh: 预处理没有移除关联 。 在本地复制上,将所有东西重新缩放到224×\times 224去除几何通道,留下的纹理差异,仍然在0.8625区分等级;在重新缩放时给出0.9297之前,等于一个常见的467-像素短轴;分辨率匹配的子集返回1.0000,因为不存在真正的匹配:"匹配的"负数为0.48兆像素对正数0.27兆像素. 在公共档案中,三种补救措施在调整大小(SD 0.0110,范围为0.8233-0.8641)后给出了0.8465,在短轴均衡后给出了0.8529(SD 0.097,范围为0.8342-0.87443),在0.9800分集下方给出了0.5兆像素(SD 0.0112,范围为0.9649-1.000),这些分集拥有来自28个病人的76个BI-RADS 1和24个BI-RADS 5图像。 在本地拷贝上,短轴均匀化得分高于纯度均匀化. 在公共档案中并没有重复这种观察,在公共档案中,两者在一个SD中相差0.006,这里不主张. 我们没有进一步测试的解释是,重新取样不能给这两类人一个共同的历史:它不能恢复底片没有共同规模的信息,也不能增加正片所携带的压缩签名。

blocks.en: Scale, had the headers been uninformative. The local copy holds 501 patients and 1,000 breasts, of which 60 are BI-RADS 4–5 (50 and 10 respectively) against 938 BI-RADS 1. With a 25% test split that is about 15 positive test breasts, for which the smallest detectable AUC difference is roughly 0.15, far above the 0.02 that the planned benchmark targeted. The local copy could not have supported that benchmark even with uninformative headers. The counts 938 / 50 / 10 exclude the 2 case-side units whose folder labels conflict; forcing a label onto those 2 units gives 939 / 51 / 10. Both sets of counts are kept.
blocks.zh: 标度,如果信头是非信息化的。 当地抄本收录了501名患者和1000个乳房,其中60个是BI-RADS 4–5(分别为50和10),对938个BI-RADS 1. 25%的测试分数约为15个正测试乳房,其中可检测到的AUC最小差约为0.15,远高于计划目标基准0.02. 即使没有信息头,本地副本也无法支持这一基准。 938 / 50 / 10 的罪状排除了文件夹标签有冲突的2个案面单位;强迫标签到这两个单位上给出了939 / 51 / 10. 两套计数都保留下来。

blocks.en: Categories absent. BI-RADS 0 and BI-RADS 2 are absent from the local copy, and its BI-RADS 3 folder holds a single file that does not match the naming convention. The public archive also has no BI-RADS 0 or BI-RADS 2 folder; its BI-RADS 3 folder holds 387 images.
blocks.zh: 没有分类。 BI-RADS 0和BI-RADS 2没有出现在本地副本中,其BI-RADS 3文件夹持有一个与命名公约不符的单一文件. 公共档案馆也没有任何BI-RADS 0或BI-RADS 2文件夹;其BI-RADS 3文件夹持有387个图像.

blocks.en: 3.3 CMMD: the sub-collection prefix predicts the diagnosis
blocks.zh: 3.3 CMMD:子收集前缀预测诊断

blocks.en: Table 7: CMMD by sub-collection, from the label file.
blocks.zh: 表7:从标签文件中根据子收藏的CMMD.

blocks.en: D1 is 50.9% malignant and D2 is 98.4% malignant; molecular subtype is recorded for 97.9% of D2 and for none of D1. The prefix alone predicts malignancy at AUC 0.7753 (0.775303 at full precision, re-derived from the label file). The two-part structure is described by the dataset’s authors [ 26 ] . What we measure is its consequence: any analysis that pools D1 and D2 without controlling for the sub-collection inherits a channel worth AUC 0.7753.
blocks.zh: D1为50.9%恶性,D2为98.4%恶性;分子亚型记录为97.9%的D2,没有D1. 单前缀在AUC 0.7753(0.775303 完全精确,从标签文件中重新衍生)预测恶性. 数据集作者对两部分结构的描述[26]. 我们衡量的是其后果:任何不控制子集的D1和D2集合的分析都会继承一个价值为AUC 0.7753的通道.

blocks.en: The geometry control returns exactly 0.5000 on CMMD, and the manifest shows why: all 5,202 images have identical pixel dimensions of 2294 × \times 1914, so the geometry feature vector is constant and the control is at chance by construction. Bit depth is not uniform: 5,200 images are stored at 8 bits and 2 at 16. An earlier check on a sample of two series had recorded the archive as uniform at 8 bits; both observations are kept.
blocks.zh: 几何控制在CMMD上完全返回0.5000,显示显示原因: 所有5,202个图像的像素尺寸相同,为2294×\times 1914,因此几何特征矢量是恒定的,通过构造控制是偶然的. 比特深度不统一:5200张图像存储在8位,2张存储在16位. 早先对两个系列样本的检查记录了8比特的档案统一;这两个观测结果都保留下来。

blocks.en: The texture control failed on the pooled dataset at 0.6275 against the 0.60 threshold, and that failure is what triggered the investigation of the sub-collections. After restriction to D1 and re-freezing of the splits, geometry is 0.5000 and texture is 0.5810, both below the stop. We read the D1 texture value as a floor and not as a defect, on the untested assumption that global texture statistics covary with breast density; under that reading a model scoring at or below 0.58 on D1 has shown nothing beyond what four global statistics provide.
blocks.zh: 在0.6275对0.60阈值的集合数据集上,纹理控制失败了,这一失败正是引发对子集的调查的原因. 在限制到D1并重新冻结分裂后,几何学为0.5000,纹理为0.5810,两者均在停站下方. 我们把D1纹理值看成是地板,而不是缺陷,因为未经测试的假设是,全球纹理统计与乳房密度交织在一起;根据这一假设,在D1上读到0.58分或低于0.58分的模型,除了四个全球统计所提供的数据之外,没有任何东西显示。

blocks.en: Age alone scores 0.6832 on the pooled dataset and 0.6744 on D1. Both values are reported as context and neither stops a study: CMMD is a diagnostic cohort in which age is associated with malignancy, which is a property of the population. The value is nonetheless useful to a reader of any CMMD result, because it is the performance a model must exceed before it has shown that it uses the image.
blocks.zh: 仅年龄在集合数据集上得分0.6832分,在D1上得分0.6744分. 这两种数值都作为上下文报告,而且没有停止一项研究: CMMD是一个诊断组群,年龄与恶意有关,这是人口的财产。 不过,该值对任何CMMD结果的读者有用,因为模型在显示使用图像之前必须超过的性能。

blocks.en: 3.4 CMMD D1: identifier order predicts the diagnosis (post hoc control)
blocks.zh: 3.4 集束弹药委员会 D1: 识别命令预测诊断(后临时控制)

blocks.en: Table 8: Identifier-order control on CMMD D1. The only feature is the serial number in the patient identifier. This control was added post hoc and is exploratory.
blocks.zh: 表8:CMMD D1上的识别器顺序控制. 唯一特征是患者识别码中的序列号. 这一控制是事后添加的,是探索性的。

blocks.en: The malignant fraction by decile of serial number, from the lowest serial numbers to the highest, is 0.54, 0.36, 0.89, 0.43, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00, 0.88, 1.00 and 0.98. The released label file is thus ordered in long runs of one diagnosis, and a classifier that sees nothing but a record’s position recovers the label almost perfectly.
blocks.zh: 序列号的恶性分数从最低序列号到最高序列号为0.54、0.36、0.89、0.43、0.00、0.00、0.08、1.00和0.98。 因此,发布标签文件是在一个诊断的长期中订购的,一个只看到记录位置的分类器几乎完全恢复了标签。

blocks.en: Three consequences follow. First, CMMD restricted to D1 passes the registered geometry and texture controls (0.5000 and 0.5810) and fails this control; it is not a clean negative control. Second, the result shows inside this paper that a pass on the registered controls is not a certificate. Third, the released gate now specifies a fifth control, identifier order, and states that it was added post hoc.
blocks.zh: 三果随顺. 首先,仅限于D1的CMMD通过注册的几何和纹理控制(0.5000和0.5810),并未能实现这种控制;它不是一个干净的负控制. 其次,结果显示,在本文中,注册控件的传递不是证书. 第三,释放的大门现在指定了第五个控制,标识顺序,并声明它是在临时后添加的.

blocks.en: An identifier is not a property of the image, and a model given pixels alone cannot read it directly. Whether any image property covaries with serial order, for example through acquisition period, was not tested. The same leakage was found in a separate benchmark by the authors, where it led to the withdrawal of an arm that used CMMD D1.
blocks.zh: 一个标识符不是图像的属性,一个给定像素的模型不能直接读取. 是否测试过任何带有序列顺序的图像属性库,例如通过获取期。 提交人在一个单独的基准中发现了同样的渗漏,从而导致使用CMMD D1的手臂被提取。

blocks.en: The same control on CBIS-DDSM (also post hoc) stays below the stop: mean AUC 0.5308 for the calcification cohort (1,511 images, 753 patients), 0.4777 for the mass cohort (1,592 images, 892 patients) and 0.5399 pooled (3,103 images, 1,566 patients), with every one of the 60 split values at or below 0.5570; on the official splits it gives 0.5299 (calcification, 284 test images) and 0.4451 (mass, 361 test images). The malignant fraction by serial decile is uneven in the calcification cohort (0.34 to 0.46 in deciles 1–9, 0.66 in decile 10), but the identifier alone does not separate the classes. The CBIS-DDSM label files therefore do not carry the CMMD ordering defect, and the CBIS-DDSM verdict rests on geometry alone.
blocks.zh: CBIS-DDSM的相同控制(也是临时控制)仍停留在站台以下:计算组群的AUC 0.5308(1 511幅图像,753位病人),质量组群的0.4777(1 592幅图像,892位病人)和0.5399集合(3 103幅图像,1 566位病人),60个分裂值中的每一一个值在0.5570或以下;在正式分裂中,它给出0.5299(计算,284幅测试图像)和0.4451(质量,361幅测试图像)。 连续十分位数的恶性分位数在钙化组群中不均匀(十分位数1–9,0.46至十分位数10),但单用标识符并不能将分类区分开来. 因此,CBIS-DDSM标签文件不携带CMMD命令的缺陷,CBIS-DDSM的判决仅依赖于几何.

blocks.en: 3.5 CBIS-DDSM: a geometry–label association above the stop
blocks.zh: 3.5 CBIS-DDSM: 站台上方的几何-标签关联

blocks.en: Every full-field image was located from its own DICOM header (10,229 DICOM objects read; 2,853 full mammograms identified by series description and patient identifier) and joined to the official case-description files. The label is image-level pathology: malignant if any annotated lesion on the image is malignant, otherwise benign. The official per-cohort splits were kept, and patients were grouped across the two cohorts.
blocks.zh: 每个全场图像都从自己的DICOM头部找到(10,229个DICOM对象读取;2,853个完整的乳房X光图由序列描述和病人识别特征识别),并加入了官方的病例描述文件. 标签是图像层面的病理学:如果图像上附加说明的任何损伤都是恶性的,否则是良性的. 官方每科的分数被保留下来,病人被分成两个组别。

blocks.en: Table 9: Geometry control on CBIS-DDSM. The mean over 20 repeated splits is the verdict statistic and was chosen after the results were seen; the official single-split value is given beside it.
blocks.zh: 表9 CBIS-DDSM上的几何控制. 平均超过20个重复的分裂是判决统计,是在看到结果后选择的;官方的单一分裂值就放在旁边。

blocks.en: The association is weaker than in KAU-BCMD and is not a lookup: the classes share 122 image dimensions in the pooled cohort, and 2,448 distinct sizes occur among 2,853 images. It is above the stop in all 60 repeated splits. The verdict nevertheless depends on a choice made after the results were seen. On the single official splits the mass cohort scores 0.5884 and the calcification cohort 0.5625, the latter on only 37 test images, and both are below the stop; the pooled cohort still exceeds it at 0.6182 with the 31 overlapping patients removed. We therefore describe the result as a failure of the geometry control under the repeated-split statistic, and not as a defect of the dataset. The mechanism was not investigated in this study, and nothing here attributes the association to a particular acquisition, digitisation or curation step.
blocks.zh: 与KAU-BCMD相比,协会实力较弱,不是一种仰视:各班在集合组中共有122个图像维度,2,853个图像中出现2,448个不同大小的图像。 在所有60次重复的拆分中,它都位于停站之上。 然而,判决取决于在看到结果之后作出的选择。 在单官方分数上,质量组群得分为0.5884分,钙化组群得分为0.5625分,后者在仅37个测试图像上,两者都低于停站;集合组群仍超过0.6182分,31个重叠患者被移除. 因此,我们把这一结果描述为重复分解统计下的几何控制失败,而不是数据集的缺陷。 本研究没有调查这一机制,这里没有将关联归结为特定的获取,数字化或研究步骤.

blocks.en: One feature of the copy bounds the calcification result. The calcification test split is almost absent from it, 37 of 284 official breast-views, so the calcification row describes mainly the official training images.
blocks.zh: 副本的一个特征是将计算结果绑定. 钙化测试分裂几乎没有出现在其中,284个正式乳房视图中的37个,因此钙化行主要描述官方训练图像.

blocks.en: The two official cohorts also interact with the official splits. Once the calcification and mass cohorts are combined, 31 patients appear in both the official training and the official test split, 18 in calcification-training and mass-test and 13 the other way round, and 29 breast-views are in both splits; within either cohort alone there is no overlap. Any analysis that pools the two cohorts while keeping the official splits places those patients on both sides. Patient-level leakage on CBIS-DDSM arising from evaluation protocols has been quantified by others [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 两个官团也与官团分开互动. 一旦钙化和质团合并,31名患者在正式培训和正式测试中均出现,18名患者在钙化培训和质团测试中出现,另外13名患者则出现,29名乳房观处于两种分裂状态;在任何一种人群中,单独存在重叠。 任何将两组人集中在一起,同时保持官分制的分析,都使这些病人处于两侧。 由评价协议产生的CBIS-DDSM的患者水平渗漏已由其他人量化[15]。

blocks.en: 3.6 Datasets that passed the controls run on them
blocks.zh: 3.6 传送控制器的数据集

blocks.en: M-SYNTH passes both available controls: whole-image physics features score 0.5070 and metadata alone, breast density and dose label, scores 0.5000, the latter 0.50 by construction.
blocks.zh: M-SYNTH通过两种可用的控制:全图像物理特征得分0.5070,单元数据,乳房密度和剂量标签,得分0.5000,后0.50通过构造.

blocks.en: INbreast passes the geometry control at a mean of 0.4863 (range 0.4367–0.5153). Its 379 analysed images take only two sizes, 2560 × \times 3328 and 3328 × \times 4084, and both occur in both classes.
blocks.zh: INBreste通过几何控制,平均值为0.4863(范围为0.4367–0.5153). 其379分析的影像只取两种尺寸,2560×时3328和3328×时4084,两者都发生在两个班级.

blocks.en: The available VinDr-Mammo subset passes at 0.5732 (range 0.5654–0.5797), the pass closest to the stop; 21 image dimensions are shared between the classes. This value describes 11,965 of the 20,000 released images, with the available share between 57.9% and 69.7% in every cell of split by BI-RADS category. It is not a property of the complete release, and the subset may be selected in ways the control cannot see.
blocks.zh: 现有的VinDr-Mammo子集通过时为0.5732(范围为0.5654-0.5797),通过时最靠近站点;21个图像维度由各阶层共享. 该值描述了20,000张已发布的图像中的11,965张,在按BI-RADS类别划分的每个单元格中,可用的份额在57.9%至69.7%之间. 这不是完全释放的属性,子集可能以控制无法看到的方式选择.

blocks.en: Only the geometry control was run on INbreast and VinDr-Mammo, and only two controls exist for M-SYNTH. A pass on one or two controls is not a clean bill of health, as Section 3.4 shows for a dataset that passed two.
blocks.zh: 在INBreast和VinDr-Mammo上运行的只有几何控制,对于M-SYNTH只有两个控制. 如第3.4节所示,一两个控制器的通过并不是一个干净的健康账单,而是一个通过两个控制器的数据集。

blocks.en: 3.7 Registered items that were not completed
blocks.zh: 3.7 未完成的登记物品

blocks.en: The second publisher route for KAU-BCMD was not checked, the archive was not obtained under an institutional account, and it is not established which export produced the local folder or whether the 800-pixel width difference reflects cropping, padding or a different release.
blocks.zh: KAU- BCMD 的第二个出版商路线没有被检查,档案没有在一个机构账户下获得,也没有确定哪个导出本地文件夹,或者800像素宽度的差异是否反映了裁剪,补丁或不同的发布.

blocks.en: The RSNA challenge dataset [ 38 ] and BreastMNIST [ 39 ] were not gated. The texture, batch/site, covariate and bit-depth controls were not run on CBIS-DDSM, INbreast or VinDr-Mammo.
blocks.zh: RSNA挑战数据集[38]和MERSTMNIST[39]没有入门. CBIS-DDSM、INBreast或VinDr-Mammo上没有进行纹理、批量/场地、共变和位深控制。

blocks.en: The registration stated that the generalisation claim would be withdrawn if all five further datasets passed. Under the registered single-split design the CBIS-DDSM mass and calcification cohorts are each below the stop, and only the pooled cohort, a configuration we constructed, exceeds it. Whether that condition is met therefore depends on the post hoc statistic or on counting the pooled configuration. We claim only that the controls returned values above the stop on some configurations of a third dataset.
blocks.zh: 登记表明,如果另外五个数据集全部通过,一般化索赔将被撤回。 在注册的单片设计下,CBIS-DDSM质量和钙化组群均位于停站以下,只有集合组群,即我们构建的配置,超过了它. 因此,是否满足这一条件取决于事后统计数据或计算集合组合。 我们只声称,控制器在第三个数据集的某些配置上返回了超过站点的值。

blocks.en: The initial controls were not re-run over repeated splits. The two texture values at 0.6275 and 0.5810 lie on either side of the 0.60 stop, and dispersion for them could change a verdict; the batch prefix at 0.7753 does not share that weakness.
blocks.zh: 最初的控制没有在重复拆分的情况下重新运行。 0.6275和0.5810的两个纹理值位于0.60站的两侧,对它们的散射可能改变一个判决;0.7753的批次前缀并不认同这一弱点.

blocks.en: The downstream cost of a failing control, meaning the change in a conventional classifier’s AUC with and without the leaking channel, was not measured.
blocks.zh: 控制失败的下游成本,即常规分类器的AUC有漏气通道和没有漏气通道的变化,没有被计量.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 What the controls cost and what they are
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 控制成本和成本

blocks.en: The geometry control reads four integers per file and decodes no pixels. For a dataset of about 2,000 images, such as the 1,991-image KAU-BCMD inventories, the classifier fit takes seconds. Reading the headers is the larger cost when files sit in cloud storage: for a 10,000-object dataset it takes minutes (the notebooks ran in about four minutes for the 10,229 CBIS-DDSM objects and about 25 minutes for the VinDr-Mammo subset). The texture control decodes pixels and is slower. On the three datasets with a failure the controls returned 1.0000 on the local KAU-BCMD copy and 0.979 on the public archive, 0.654 on pooled CBIS-DDSM under the repeated-split statistic and, through the batch control, 0.7753 on CMMD. Set against the cost of a benchmark built on a compromised cohort, the cost of the controls is small. That is the argument for running them at intake and not only when something looks wrong.
blocks.zh: 几何控制器每个文件读4个整数,解码无像素. 对于大约2000幅图像的数据集,如1,991-图像的KAU-BCMD目录,分类器适配需要几秒钟. 在云存储中阅读文件头是更大的成本:对于一个1万个对象的数据集来说,需要几分钟(对于10,229个CBIS-DDSM对象来说,笔记本在4分钟内运行,对于VinDr-Mammo子集来说约为25分钟). 纹理控制解码像素且速度较慢. 在三套故障数据集上,控制器在本地的KAU-BCMD副本上返回了1.0000,在公共档案上返回了0.979,在重复分散统计下返回了集合的CBIS-DDSM,通过批量控制,返回了CMMD上的0.7753。 对照以受损组群为基础的基准成本,控制成本很小。 这就是在录取时运行它们的论点,而不仅是在看似不对时。

blocks.en: Two properties of the design are separable from its implementation. The controls are impoverished by construction: they receive inputs that should not carry diagnostic content, so a high score is hard to interpret as anything but leakage. This makes them more informative than a performance ceiling or a learning curve, either of which can be explained by model capacity. And the covariate control is reported and not enforced, because a gate that stopped a study on the ground that age predicts malignancy in a diagnostic cohort would be measuring epidemiology.
blocks.zh: 设计的两个属性与其实施可分离. 控制因构造而变得贫乏:它们得到的投入不应包含诊断内容,因此,高分很难被解释为除了渗漏以外的任何东西。 这使得它们比一个性能上限或学习曲线更能提供信息,两者都可以用模型能力来解释. 而共变控制被报告而不是强制实施, 因为一个阻止研究的门 以年龄预测 诊断组群的恶性 将测量流行病学。

blocks.en: 4.2 Resizing is not a defence, and the mechanisms differ
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 调整规模不是辩护,机制不同

blocks.en: On KAU-BCMD, resizing to a standard input size did not neutralise the association. It removed the geometry channel and left a texture difference that separates the classes at 0.8625 on the local copy and 0.8465 on the public archive; equalising the short axis first did not help on either copy (0.9297 locally, 0.8529 on the public archive). In this dataset the confound is carried by the information content of the image and not only by its dimensions, so matching dimensions addresses what a reader can see and leaves the cause in place.
blocks.zh: 在KAU-BCMD上,重新大小到标准输入大小并不能抵消关联. 它移除了几何通道,留下了纹理差异,在本地拷贝上将各类分别为0.8625和0.8465;在两个拷贝上均匀的短轴首先无济于事(0.9297本地,0.8529在公共档案上). 在这个数据集中,混沌是由图像的信息内容所携带的,而不仅仅是它的维度,因此匹配的维度解决了读者能够看到的,并留下了原因.

blocks.en: CMMD shows a different mechanism with the same consequence. The archive is dimensionally uniform and returns chance on geometry. What fails is that two sub-collections with 50.9% and 98.4% malignancy are distributed together, so that the identifier prefix alone reaches AUC 0.7753. Neither the geometry control nor the batch control would have caught the other’s dataset, which is the argument for more than one control. CBIS-DDSM shows a third pattern: no single dimension separates the classes, yet the joint distribution of size and shape is associated with the label above the stop under repeated splits. A check that only looked for image sizes unique to one class, without scoring a classifier, would not have flagged it.
blocks.zh: CMMD显示一个具有相同后果的不同机制. 档案在维度上是统一的,在几何学上还有机会. 失败的是两个分集的50.9%和98.4%恶性分布在一起,因此仅标识前缀就达到了AUC 0.7753. 无论是几何控制还是批量控制都不可能捕捉到对方的数据集,这是多个控制的理由. CBIS-DDSM显示的是第三种模式:没有单个维度将类分开,然而大小和形状的联合分布与在重复分割下停站上方的标签有关. 一个只寻找一个类独有的图像大小的检查,而不给一个分类器打分,就不会标出它.

blocks.en: 4.3 A pass is not a certificate
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 通行证不是证书

blocks.en: CMMD D1 is the instructive case. It was adopted as the corrected cohort after the pooled dataset failed, it passed both registered stop controls, and it remained the working cohort until the identifier-order control was added. A control that had not been anticipated, the serial number in the identifier, then returned a test AUC of 0.9926. A set of controls can only detect the channels its authors anticipated; a single untuned learner gives a lower bound on leakage and not an upper one. The appropriate reading of every “pass” in Table 4 is that no leakage was detected by the controls that were run, and for INbreast and VinDr-Mammo that means one control.
blocks.zh: CMMD 数据 D1是具有启发性的案例。 它在集合数据集失败后被采纳为校正组,它通过了两个已注册的停止控制,在添加标识命令控制之前它仍然是工作组。 一个没有预料到的控制,标识符中的序列号,然后返回了0.9926的测试AUC. 一套控制只能探测其作者所预期的渠道;一个单一的未调试的学习者对渗漏给予较低的约束,而不是上限. 对表4中每个“通道”的正确解读是,运行的控制没有发现渗漏,对INBreast和VinDr-Mammo来说,这意味着一种控制。

blocks.en: The identifier-order control was added after the fact, and adding controls after a result is known is itself a forking path. We report it as exploratory for that reason, and we do not claim that five controls are sufficient where four were not.
blocks.zh: 标识符-顺序控制是在事实之后添加的,结果已知后添加控制本身就是一种伪造路径. 为此原因,我们把它作为探索性报告,而且我们并不认为,如果有五个控制,那么就足够了。

blocks.en: 4.4 Implications for users of these datasets
blocks.zh: 4.4 对数据集用户的影响

blocks.en: The KAU-BCMD association is present in the public Kaggle archive identified in Table 3, so it bears on any study trained on that archive, and a reader can run the check on their own copy. We do not extend the statement to other distributions of the dataset. The CMMD findings are properties of the released label file: the sub-collection prefix and the serial number are in the identifier of every row, and an analysis that pools D1 and D2, or that uses record order within D1 in any way, inherits the corresponding channel. For CBIS-DDSM, geometry is associated with pathology above the stop under repeated splits but not on the official mass and calcification splits, and pooling the two official cohorts under the official splits puts 31 patients on both sides.
blocks.zh: KAU-BCMD协会存在于表3中确认的公开的Kaggle档案中,因此它与任何关于该档案的经过培训的研究有关,读者可自行核对其副本。 我们不把声明扩大到数据集的其他分布。 CMMD的发现是已发布的标签文件的属性:子收集前缀和序列号位于每行的标识符中,分析集合D1和D2,或者以任何方式使用D1内部的记录顺序,继承相应的通道. 对于CBIS-DDSM来说,几何学在反复分裂下与停站之上的病理有关,但不在官方质量和钙化分裂上有关,在官方分裂下将两个官方群体集中在一起使双方有31个病人.

blocks.en: The practical recommendation is narrow and testable: report the control AUCs in any paper that trains on a public mammography dataset; state the sub-collection composition when pooling; check patient overlap whenever official splits from different cohorts are combined; and treat record order and identifiers as potential label carriers.
blocks.zh: 实际建议范围狭窄,可以测试:在任何在公共乳房X光照相数据集上进行训练的纸张中报告控制AUC;在集合时说明分集组成;在官方与不同组群的分裂合并时检查病人的重叠情况;并将记录顺序和识别符视为潜在的标签载体。

blocks.en: 4.5 Context within a quantum-versus-classical programme
blocks.zh: 4.5 量子与古典方案的背景

blocks.en: This paper belongs beside a set of quantum-versus-classical comparisons only because the controls were written to protect them. Its relation to the proposed framework for quantum advantage [ 36 ] is limited to one observation: where the framework asks that the correctness of an output be validated, a dataset whose label is readable from its file header prevents that validation for every arm, and the deficiency precedes anything the computation does. The framework is a proposal by authors affiliated with quantum-computing vendors, and we adopt none of its forecasts. This paper reports no quantum advantage, no speed-up and no quantum-enhanced performance, offers no quantum result as evidence of any benefit, and there is no quantum component in the inference path.
blocks.zh: 本文属于一套量子比较和古典比较之外,只是因为控件是用来保护它们的。 其与拟议量子优势框架的关系[36]仅限于一种观察:当框架要求验证一个输出的正确性时,一个其标签可以从文件头读取的数据集会阻碍每个臂的验证,而缺陷先于任何计算. 该框架是隶属于量子计算供应商的作者提出的一项提案,我们没有采纳任何预测。 本文报告没有量子优势,没有速度,也没有量子增强性能,没有提供任何量子结果作为任何好处的证据,推论路径中也没有量子成分.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: 1. The KAU-BCMD archive is one of two registered routes, and its provenance is incomplete. The association is confirmed in one Kaggle-hosted archive, identified here by file name, size and member dates. The hosting page, uploader and version were not recorded at download. The archive’s file name matches the identifier of the Kaggle page given in the dataset paper’s data-availability statement [ 25 ] (https://www.kaggle.com/asmaasaad/king-abdulaziz-university-mammogram-dataset), which is consistent with the dataset authors’ own deposit but does not establish it; a re-upload by a third party is not excluded. The second registered route was not checked. 2. The KAU-BCMD analysis of the local copy was not registered. It was an ad hoc diagnostic, the gate was formalised afterwards, and the result is exploratory. 3. The registration is internal. It is a dated written protocol with a deviations log, released with the code, and not a record in a public registry. 4. The batch/site and identifier-order controls are post hoc additions. The CMMD sub-collection confound was found by investigation after the texture control failed, and the identifier-order control was added after the registered gate had passed CMMD D1, then applied to CBIS-DDSM. The five-control gate released here is therefore partly retrospective in design. 5. The initial results are single runs at one seed. No dispersion is available for them, and the two texture values at 0.6275 and 0.5810 lie on either side of the stop. 6. The verdict statistic for the follow-up results was chosen after the results were seen. The follow-up results carry 20-split dispersion and their verdict is taken on the mean. On the single official splits the CBIS-DDSM mass cohort scores 0.5884 and the calcification cohort 0.5625 (37 test images), both below the stop, while the pooled cohort exceeds it at 0.6182 with the 31 overlapping patients removed. 7. For CBIS-DDSM the premise of the geometry control is weaker. In a digitised-film dataset cropped to the breast, image size may partly reflect breast size or the digitiser or site, neither of which was tested, so for CBIS-DDSM the premise that geometry carries no diagnostic information is weaker than for the fixed-format digital datasets. 8. A single untuned classifier gives a lower bound on leakage. A control that fails has failed; a control that passes means only that this learner, on these features, found nothing. The gate is a one-sided screen and a pass is not a certificate, as the CMMD D1 result shows. 9. Protocols are not uniform across datasets. The local KAU-BCMD copy is cross-validated once, CMMD and M-SYNTH are scored once on a frozen split, and the follow-up analyses are scored over 20 repeated cross-validation splits. The available controls differ because the recorded metadata differ, and only the geometry control was run on CBIS-DDSM, INbreast and VinDr-Mammo. 10. The scripts that produced the initial KAU-BCMD and CMMD D1 values are not available. The released gate script is a reconstruction from their written specification and is not the code that produced those values. The raw inputs and the measured outputs are released; the transformation between them is documented in prose for those rows. The follow-up results are produced end to end by the released notebooks, saved with their outputs. 11. The registered checksums of the pooled CMMD splits cannot be verified. The pooled split files were replaced when the protocol was amended to D1 and are not recoverable. Both the registered and the realised checksums are reported in the release. 12. Six datasets are a small base for a general recommendation. KAU-BCMD and CMMD are the two datasets in which the first failures were found, so that part of the sample is not independent of the finding. CBIS-DDSM, INbreast and VinDr-Mammo were named in the registration before they were examined. 13. Three sizes are on record for KAU-BCMD and they disagree. The dataset paper reports 1,416 cases and 5,662 images [ 25 ] ; the IEEE DataPort record of the dataset lists 1,521 cases and 6,109 images; and a benchmark compilation that includes the dataset [ 33 ] lists 1,416 cases and 2,206 JPG images. We confirmed the first against the abstract of the dataset paper and the third against an excerpt of the compilation’s text. The second is as transcribed during our initial dataset verification and was not re-checked for this manuscript. The disagreement is unresolved. It affects no control AUC, but the denominator of any statement about the dataset as a whole is uncertain. 14. CMMD bit depth is not uniform. A full pass over the manifest finds 5,200 images at 8 bits and 2 at 16, against an earlier sampled check that recorded 8 bits throughout. Both values are kept, and a bit-depth check is added to the gate. 15. BI-RADS is a radiologist-assigned category and not pathology. The KAU-BCMD, INbreast and VinDr-Mammo labels are a different kind of object from the pathology labels of CMMD and CBIS-DDSM, and BI-RADS 0 is a workflow action and not a tissue state. 16. The follow-up copies are incomplete or partly characterised. VinDr-Mammo is 59.8% of the release; the CBIS-DDSM copy lacks 247 of 284 official calcification-test breast-views; the INbreast access agreement is not on file. Each result describes the copy analysed. 17. Patient identity in KAU-BCMD is inferred from file names. 64 case numbers recur under two year prefixes; grouping by case number alone changes the archive AUC by 0.001 (Table 6), but the patient structure is not documented by the publisher. 18. The texture definitions were fixed for the follow-up re-run. The initial analysis did not define them numerically, so the local and public texture AUCs are not demonstrably computed in the same way. 19. Not assessed. Whether the controls detect confounds other than geometry, texture, batch, identifier order and a single covariate; any dataset outside mammography; and the downstream performance cost of a failing control. 20. Threshold choice. The verdicts depend on the threshold only near it. Re-scoring the 24 stop-role results at 0.55, 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75 changes the number of failing results from 14 at 0.60 to 16, 12, 10 and 10. The failures of both KAU-BCMD copies and of pooled CMMD do not depend on the threshold anywhere in that range, because each rests on at least one value of 0.7753 or above. Three dataset-level verdicts do depend on it: CBIS-DDSM fails on geometry for any threshold up to 0.6876 and passes at 0.70; VinDr-Mammo, which passes at 0.60 with a mean of 0.5732, would fail at 0.55; and CMMD D1, which passes its registered controls at 0.60, would fail them at 0.55 through its texture value of 0.5810. Every value is reported in full, so a reader who prefers another threshold can re-score each dataset directly.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 KAU-BCMD档案是两条注册路线之一,其出处不全. 协会在Kaggle托管的档案中被确认,档案名称、大小和成员日期在此确定。 在下载时没有记录主机页面,上传器和版本. 存档文件名符合数据集文件数据可用性说明[25](https://www.kaggle.com/asmaasaad/king-abdulaziz-university-mammogram-dataset)中给出的Kaggle页面标识符,该标识符与数据集作者本人的保存一致,但并不确定;第三方的重载不排除. 第二条注册路线没有检查 。 2. KAU-BCMD对当地副本的分析没有登记。 这是一种临时诊断,大门后来被正式确定,结果是探索性的。 3. 登记是内部的。 这是一种带有偏差日志的注明日期的书面协议,与代码一起发布,而不是公共登记处的记录. 4. 批次/现场和标识顺序控制是临时增加的。 在纹理控制失败后,通过调查发现了CMMD子收集混乱,在注册的门通过CMMD D1之后,添加了标识命令控制,然后应用于CBIS-DDSM. 因此,在此发布的五控门在设计上具有部分追溯性. 5. 初步结果为单一种子。 它们没有散射,0.6275和0.5810的两个纹理值位于停站的两侧. 6. 后续结果的判决统计是在看到结果之后选定的。 后续结果带有20个零散的分布,其判决是按平均值作出的。 CBIS-DDSM质量组分0.5884分,钙化组分0.5625分(37张测试图像),均在停机坪以下,集合组分0.6182分,31名重叠患者被移除。 7. 对CBIS-DDSM来说,几何控制的前提较弱。 在剪切到乳房的数字化-胶卷数据集中,图像尺寸可能部分反映乳房大小或凹槽器或站点,两者都没有经过测试,因此,对于CBIS-DDSM来说,几何带诊断信息的前提比固定格式的数字数据集要弱. 8. 单一未调整的分类器对渗漏的约束力较低。 一个失败的控制失败了;一个通过的控制只意味着这个学习者在这些特性上一无所获. 如CMMD D1结果所示,大门为单面屏幕,通过不是证书. 9. 各数据集的协议并不统一。 本地的KAU-BCMD拷贝为一次交叉验证,CMMD和M-SYNTH在一次冷冻分裂中得分一次,后续分析在20多次交叉验证分裂中得分一次. 可用的控制因记录的元数据不同而不同,只有CBIS-DDSM,INBreast和VinDr-Mammo运行了几何控制. 10. 产生KAU-BCMD和CMMD D1值的脚本没有。 释放的门脚本是从其书面规格中重建出来的,而不是产生这些值的代码. 原始投入和计量产出被公布;它们之间的转变用这些行的旁白记录下来。 后续结果由发行的笔记本最终产生,用其产出节省下来. 11. CMMD拆分的登记核对和无法核实。 集合拆分文件在协议修改为D1时被替换,无法回收. 已登记和已实现的核对结果均在释放中报告。 12. 六个数据集是一般性建议的一个小基础。 KAU-BCMD和CMMD是发现第一批故障的两个数据集,因此部分样本不独立于发现. CBIS-DDSM, Inbreast和VinDr-Mammo在接受检查前在注册中被命名. 13. 对KAU-BCMD来说,有三种规模的记录,他们不同意。 数据集文件报告有1,416个案例和5,662个图像[25];数据集IEEE DataPort记录列出1,521个案例和6,109个图像;包括数据集[33]的基准汇编列出1,416个案例和2,206个JPG图像. 我们确认了第一篇反对数据集文件的抽象,第三篇反对汇编文本的摘录。 第二种是在我们最初的数据集核实过程中转录的,没有重新检查这份手稿。 分歧尚未解决。 它不会影响控制AUC,但任何关于数据集整体的语句的分母都不确定. 14. CMMD比特深度不统一。 完全通过清单发现5 200幅图像,8位,2位,16位,而早先的抽样检查记录了8位。 两种值都保留下来,并在闸门上添加了比特深度的检查. 15. BI-RADS是放射学家指定的类别,不是病理学。 KAU-BCMD,INBreast和VinDr-Mammo标签是一类与CMMD和CBIS-DDSM的病理学标签不同的对象,BI-RADS 0是一个工作流程动作,而不是组织状态. 16. 后续副本不完整或部分性质。 VinDr-Mammo占发行量的59.8%;CBIS-DDSM副本缺少284个官方钙化测试乳房视图中的247个;INBreast访问协议没有存档. 每项结果都说明了所分析的副本。 17. 从档案名称推断出KAU-BCMD的病人身份。 64个病例数在两年前缀下重复出现;单按病例数分组就将档案AUC更改为0.001(表6),但患者结构没有被出版商记录. 18. 纹理定义已经确定,用于后续再运行。 最初的分析没有用数字来定义它们,因此当地和公共的纹理AUC并不是以同样的方式计算的。 19. 未分摊。 控制器是否检测出除几何、纹理、批量、标识顺序和单一共变体以外的错觉;乳房X光照相术之外的任何数据集;以及控制失败的下游性能成本。 20. 门槛选择。 判决只取决于接近的门槛. 重新评分24个止步成绩为0.55,0.65,0.70和0.75,将失败成绩从14个0.60改为16,12,10和10. KAU-BCMD副本和集合CMMD副本的失败并不取决于该范围内任何地方的阈值,因为每个值至少取决于一个值0.7753或以上。 三个数据集一级的判决的确取决于这一点:CBIS-DDSM在0.6876以下的任何阈值上都未能达到几何标准,0.70通过;VinDr-Mammo在0.60通过,平均值为0.5732;CMMD D1在0.60通过注册控制,其纹理值为0.5810,使其0.55通过。 每个值都会被完整报告,因此一个更喜欢另一个阈值的读者可以直接对每个数据集进行重新计分.

blocks.en: The KAU-BCMD archive is one of two registered routes, and its provenance is incomplete. The association is confirmed in one Kaggle-hosted archive, identified here by file name, size and member dates. The hosting page, uploader and version were not recorded at download. The archive’s file name matches the identifier of the Kaggle page given in the dataset paper’s data-availability statement [ 25 ] (https://www.kaggle.com/asmaasaad/king-abdulaziz-university-mammogram-dataset), which is consistent with the dataset authors’ own deposit but does not establish it; a re-upload by a third party is not excluded. The second registered route was not checked.
blocks.zh: KAU-BCMD档案是两条注册路线之一,其出处不全. 协会在Kaggle托管的档案中被确认,档案名称、大小和成员日期在此确定。 在下载时没有记录主机页面,上传器和版本. 存档文件名符合数据集文件数据可用性说明[25](https://www.kaggle.com/asmaasaad/king-abdulaziz-university-mammogram-dataset)中给出的Kaggle页面标识符,该标识符与数据集作者本人的保存一致,但并不确定;第三方的重载不排除. 第二条注册路线没有检查 。

blocks.en: The KAU-BCMD analysis of the local copy was not registered. It was an ad hoc diagnostic, the gate was formalised afterwards, and the result is exploratory.
blocks.zh: KAU-BCMD对本地副本的分析没有登记。 这是一种临时诊断,大门后来被正式确定,结果是探索性的。

blocks.en: The registration is internal. It is a dated written protocol with a deviations log, released with the code, and not a record in a public registry.
blocks.zh: 登记是内部的。 这是一种带有偏差日志的注明日期的书面协议,与代码一起发布,而不是公共登记处的记录.

blocks.en: The batch/site and identifier-order controls are post hoc additions. The CMMD sub-collection confound was found by investigation after the texture control failed, and the identifier-order control was added after the registered gate had passed CMMD D1, then applied to CBIS-DDSM. The five-control gate released here is therefore partly retrospective in design.
blocks.zh: 批/场和标识顺序控制是临时添加的。 在纹理控制失败后,通过调查发现了CMMD子收集混乱,在注册的门通过CMMD D1之后,添加了标识命令控制,然后应用于CBIS-DDSM. 因此,在此发布的五控门在设计上具有部分追溯性.

blocks.en: The initial results are single runs at one seed. No dispersion is available for them, and the two texture values at 0.6275 and 0.5810 lie on either side of the stop.
blocks.zh: 初步结果为单项运行于一个种子. 它们没有散射,0.6275和0.5810的两个纹理值位于停站的两侧.

blocks.en: The verdict statistic for the follow-up results was chosen after the results were seen. The follow-up results carry 20-split dispersion and their verdict is taken on the mean. On the single official splits the CBIS-DDSM mass cohort scores 0.5884 and the calcification cohort 0.5625 (37 test images), both below the stop, while the pooled cohort exceeds it at 0.6182 with the 31 overlapping patients removed.
blocks.zh: 后续结果的判决统计是在看到结果之后选定的。 后续结果带有20个零散的分布,其判决是按平均值作出的。 CBIS-DDSM质量组分0.5884分,钙化组分0.5625分(37张测试图像),均在停机坪以下,集合组分0.6182分,31名重叠患者被移除。

blocks.en: For CBIS-DDSM the premise of the geometry control is weaker. In a digitised-film dataset cropped to the breast, image size may partly reflect breast size or the digitiser or site, neither of which was tested, so for CBIS-DDSM the premise that geometry carries no diagnostic information is weaker than for the fixed-format digital datasets.
blocks.zh: 对于CBIS-DDSM来说,几何控制的前提较弱. 在剪切到乳房的数字化-胶卷数据集中,图像尺寸可能部分反映乳房大小或凹槽器或站点,两者都没有经过测试,因此,对于CBIS-DDSM来说,几何带诊断信息的前提比固定格式的数字数据集要弱.

blocks.en: A single untuned classifier gives a lower bound on leakage. A control that fails has failed; a control that passes means only that this learner, on these features, found nothing. The gate is a one-sided screen and a pass is not a certificate, as the CMMD D1 result shows.
blocks.zh: 单个未调试的分类器在渗漏时给予较低的约束. 一个失败的控制失败了;一个通过的控制只意味着这个学习者在这些特性上一无所获. 如CMMD D1结果所示,大门为单面屏幕,通过不是证书.

blocks.en: Protocols are not uniform across datasets. The local KAU-BCMD copy is cross-validated once, CMMD and M-SYNTH are scored once on a frozen split, and the follow-up analyses are scored over 20 repeated cross-validation splits. The available controls differ because the recorded metadata differ, and only the geometry control was run on CBIS-DDSM, INbreast and VinDr-Mammo.
blocks.zh: 各数据集的协议并不统一。 本地的KAU-BCMD拷贝为一次交叉验证,CMMD和M-SYNTH在一次冷冻分裂中得分一次,后续分析在20多次交叉验证分裂中得分一次. 可用的控制因记录的元数据不同而不同,只有CBIS-DDSM,INBreast和VinDr-Mammo运行了几何控制.

blocks.en: The scripts that produced the initial KAU-BCMD and CMMD D1 values are not available. The released gate script is a reconstruction from their written specification and is not the code that produced those values. The raw inputs and the measured outputs are released; the transformation between them is documented in prose for those rows. The follow-up results are produced end to end by the released notebooks, saved with their outputs.
blocks.zh: 产生最初的KAU-BCMD和CMMD D1值的脚本是没有的. 释放的门脚本是从其书面规格中重建出来的,而不是产生这些值的代码. 原始投入和计量产出被公布;它们之间的转变用这些行的旁白记录下来。 后续结果由发行的笔记本最终产生,用其产出节省下来.

blocks.en: The registered checksums of the pooled CMMD splits cannot be verified. The pooled split files were replaced when the protocol was amended to D1 and are not recoverable. Both the registered and the realised checksums are reported in the release.
blocks.zh: 集合CMMD拆分的注册校验和无法校验. 集合拆分文件在协议修改为D1时被替换,无法回收. 已登记和已实现的核对结果均在释放中报告。

blocks.en: Six datasets are a small base for a general recommendation. KAU-BCMD and CMMD are the two datasets in which the first failures were found, so that part of the sample is not independent of the finding. CBIS-DDSM, INbreast and VinDr-Mammo were named in the registration before they were examined.
blocks.zh: 六个数据集是一般性建议的一个小基础。 KAU-BCMD和CMMD是发现第一批故障的两个数据集,因此部分样本不独立于发现. CBIS-DDSM, Inbreast和VinDr-Mammo在接受检查前在注册中被命名.

blocks.en: Three sizes are on record for KAU-BCMD and they disagree. The dataset paper reports 1,416 cases and 5,662 images [ 25 ] ; the IEEE DataPort record of the dataset lists 1,521 cases and 6,109 images; and a benchmark compilation that includes the dataset [ 33 ] lists 1,416 cases and 2,206 JPG images. We confirmed the first against the abstract of the dataset paper and the third against an excerpt of the compilation’s text. The second is as transcribed during our initial dataset verification and was not re-checked for this manuscript. The disagreement is unresolved. It affects no control AUC, but the denominator of any statement about the dataset as a whole is uncertain.
blocks.zh: KAU-BCMD记录了3个尺寸,他们不同意. 数据集文件报告有1,416个案例和5,662个图像[25];数据集IEEE DataPort记录列出1,521个案例和6,109个图像;包括数据集[33]的基准汇编列出1,416个案例和2,206个JPG图像. 我们确认了第一篇反对数据集文件的抽象,第三篇反对汇编文本的摘录。 第二种是在我们最初的数据集核实过程中转录的,没有重新检查这份手稿。 分歧尚未解决。 它不会影响控制AUC,但任何关于数据集整体的语句的分母都不确定.

blocks.en: CMMD bit depth is not uniform. A full pass over the manifest finds 5,200 images at 8 bits and 2 at 16, against an earlier sampled check that recorded 8 bits throughout. Both values are kept, and a bit-depth check is added to the gate.
blocks.zh: CMMD 位深不统一 。 完全通过清单发现5 200幅图像,8位,2位,16位,而早先的抽样检查记录了8位。 两种值都保留下来,并在闸门上添加了比特深度的检查.

blocks.en: BI-RADS is a radiologist-assigned category and not pathology. The KAU-BCMD, INbreast and VinDr-Mammo labels are a different kind of object from the pathology labels of CMMD and CBIS-DDSM, and BI-RADS 0 is a workflow action and not a tissue state.
blocks.zh: BI-RADS是一个放射学家指定类别,而不是病理学. KAU-BCMD,INBreast和VinDr-Mammo标签是一类与CMMD和CBIS-DDSM的病理学标签不同的对象,BI-RADS 0是一个工作流程动作,而不是组织状态.

blocks.en: The follow-up copies are incomplete or partly characterised. VinDr-Mammo is 59.8% of the release; the CBIS-DDSM copy lacks 247 of 284 official calcification-test breast-views; the INbreast access agreement is not on file. Each result describes the copy analysed.
blocks.zh: 后续副本不完整或部分性质。 VinDr-Mammo占发行量的59.8%;CBIS-DDSM副本缺少284个官方钙化测试乳房视图中的247个;INBreast访问协议没有存档. 每项结果都说明了所分析的副本。

blocks.en: Patient identity in KAU-BCMD is inferred from file names. 64 case numbers recur under two year prefixes; grouping by case number alone changes the archive AUC by 0.001 (Table 6), but the patient structure is not documented by the publisher.
blocks.zh: 从文件名推断出KAU-BCMD中的病人身份. 64个病例数在两年前缀下重复出现;单按病例数分组就将档案AUC更改为0.001(表6),但患者结构没有被出版商记录.

blocks.en: The texture definitions were fixed for the follow-up re-run. The initial analysis did not define them numerically, so the local and public texture AUCs are not demonstrably computed in the same way.
blocks.zh: 纹理定义被固定在后续重运行中. 最初的分析没有用数字来定义它们,因此当地和公共的纹理AUC并不是以同样的方式计算的。

blocks.en: Not assessed. Whether the controls detect confounds other than geometry, texture, batch, identifier order and a single covariate; any dataset outside mammography; and the downstream performance cost of a failing control.
blocks.zh: 未分摊。 控制器是否检测出除几何、纹理、批量、标识顺序和单一共变体以外的错觉;乳房X光照相术之外的任何数据集;以及控制失败的下游性能成本。

blocks.en: Threshold choice. The verdicts depend on the threshold only near it. Re-scoring the 24 stop-role results at 0.55, 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75 changes the number of failing results from 14 at 0.60 to 16, 12, 10 and 10. The failures of both KAU-BCMD copies and of pooled CMMD do not depend on the threshold anywhere in that range, because each rests on at least one value of 0.7753 or above. Three dataset-level verdicts do depend on it: CBIS-DDSM fails on geometry for any threshold up to 0.6876 and passes at 0.70; VinDr-Mammo, which passes at 0.60 with a mean of 0.5732, would fail at 0.55; and CMMD D1, which passes its registered controls at 0.60, would fail them at 0.55 through its texture value of 0.5810. Every value is reported in full, so a reader who prefers another threshold can re-score each dataset directly.
blocks.zh: 极限选择。 判决只取决于接近的门槛. 重新评分24个止步成绩为0.55,0.65,0.70和0.75,将失败成绩从14个0.60改为16,12,10和10. KAU-BCMD副本和集合CMMD副本的失败并不取决于该范围内任何地方的阈值,因为每个值至少取决于一个值0.7753或以上。 三个数据集一级的判决的确取决于这一点:CBIS-DDSM在0.6876以下的任何阈值上都未能达到几何标准,0.70通过;VinDr-Mammo在0.60通过,平均值为0.5732;CMMD D1在0.60通过注册控制,其纹理值为0.5810,使其0.55通过。 每个值都会被完整报告,因此一个更喜欢另一个阈值的读者可以直接对每个数据集进行重新计分.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: File-level controls run before training returned values far above chance on copies of KAU-BCMD and on pooled CMMD, and above a 0.60 stop on CBIS-DDSM under a statistic chosen post hoc. A cohort that passed the registered controls then failed one added later. The controls are inexpensive, they detect only what they were built to look for, and their results, including the unremarkable ones, are worth reporting alongside any model trained on these datasets.
blocks.zh: 在培训之前,对KAU-BCMD副本和集成CMMD的数值进行远高于机会的返回值控制,在选定的员额统计下,对CBIS-DDSM进行0.60次以上的控制。 通过注册控制器的一组人随后失败,后来又增加了一组人。 控制费用低廉,它们只探测到它们所要寻找的东西,其结果,包括不值得注意的结果,值得与任何受过这些数据集培训的模型一起报告。

blocks.en: Data availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en: The derived tables that support this article are deposited in a public Zenodo repository, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24372683. The deposit contains no mammographic images. Figure 1 reproduces six images from KAU-BCMD under that dataset’s CC BY 4.0 licence.
blocks.zh: 支持本条的衍生表格存入公共Zenodo寄存处, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24372683。 押金中没有乳房造影图像。 图1转载了来自KAU-BCMD的六张图片,

blocks.en: The deposit comprises: gate_summary.csv (every control result with its source); threshold_sensitivity.csv and threshold_sensitivity_summary.json (every verdict re-scored at thresholds from 0.55 to 0.75, and the near-chance split spread); gate_results_d1.csv and gates_msynth.csv (CMMD D1 and M-SYNTH control results); gate_results_d1_identifier_order.csv and gate_results_d1_identifier_order_splits.csv (the post hoc identifier-order control on CMMD D1, frozen-split values and the 20 per-split values); gate_results_cbis_identifier_order.csv and gate_results_cbis_identifier_order_splits.csv (the same control on CBIS-DDSM, per cohort and pooled, with the 60 per-split values); cmmd_labels.csv , cmmd_manifest.csv and cmmd_batch_table.csv (CMMD label table, per-image manifest and sub-collection table); split_train.csv , split_val.csv and split_test.csv (frozen CMMD D1 splits); kau_bcmd_labelled_inventory.csv , kau_bcmd_local_inventory_redacted.csv and kau_geometry_table.csv (local KAU-BCMD inventories and dimension table; export-folder names in the local inventory are replaced by opaque labels); kau_bucket_inventory.csv (per-image width, height, bit depth, compression, file size and SHA-256 for all 2,378 images of the public KAU-BCMD archive); cbis_split_overlap_patients.csv (the 31 CBIS-DDSM patients in both official splits); checksums.sha256 and verification_log.md (checksums and the re-derivation record); and 01_preregistration.md (the internal protocol with its dated deviations log). Per-image inventories exist for the public KAU-BCMD copy only; none was produced for CBIS-DDSM, INbreast or VinDr-Mammo.

blocks.en: Broader Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响说明

blocks.en: The controls described here are meant to stop models from being trained and reported on datasets whose labels can be recovered from non-diagnostic information, which protects patients, clinicians and regulators from performance claims that say nothing about disease. Two misuses are possible. A failed control could be read as a statement that a dataset or its creators are at fault, whereas the findings describe properties of particular released copies and label files, several of them chosen or added post hoc; and a pass could be read as a certificate of quality, which the paper explicitly rejects. No images or new patient data are released; the deposit contains code and derived tables only.
blocks.zh: 这里描述的控制措施旨在阻止模型在数据集上接受培训和报告,这些数据集的标签可以从非诊断信息中恢复,这可以保护患者,临床医生和监管者免受那些对疾病一言不发的性能诉求的影响. 两种滥用是可能的。 一个失败的控制可以被理解为一种声明,即一个数据集或其创建者有过失,而结论则描述了特定发行的拷贝和标签文件的属性,其中几个选择或添加了事后临时文件;一个通行证可以读作质量证书,而纸上明确拒绝. 没有发布图像或新的病人数据;押金只包含代码和衍生表格.
